label: Original-phase input of t/k/o/2/g/y (not at step 0)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase: 99% of activation mass. It never fires at t=0, at the <DEL> step, or in the copy phase (about 1% of mass there). It responds to a small set of input tokens: t, k, o, 2, g, y each have about 4-5x lift and together carry about 83% of the mass. e, r, l, q, 3 are weaker. Activation is highest at original positions 3-5 and drops off after position 6. It is stronger on the first occurrence of a token (in_first carries 91% of the mass) and when the sequence starts with f, i, s or 1. The token-set predicate gets mass recall 0.83 but precision only 0.45: whether one of these tokens fires depends on earlier context that no simple prefix-set condition captured (adding seen-token, position or first-occurrence conditions changed F1 by less than 0.02).
